headline: Accellera opens PSS 3.1 draft for public review
fact: Accellera listed the Portable Stimulus Standard Draft 3.1 for public review on August 31, 2026, with comments open through September 30. Accellera describes 3.1 as a focused update to PSS 3.0 covering a stronger constraint language, more reusable libraries, greater control over generated target code, and improved address-space/register modeling.
